native_context: Untrusted image/document worker capabilities and isolation
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Untrusted image/document worker capabilities and isolation — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Open converter invocation, effective parser/delegate policy, container/sandbox configuration, working directory, output publication and resource budgets. Identify actual format support.
controls.controlled_verification: Use tiny owned documents with inert local resource markers and a normal conversion control. In an isolated worker observe file/network/delegate attempts and resulting output authority. A configuration file is relevant only if that process actually loads it.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A supported document feature or delegate binary on disk is not proof of reachable execution. A sandboxed resolver denial establishes attempted access, not successful host-file disclosure.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Restrict required parsers/delegates and isolate file/network/identity/resource access at the worker. Retest legitimate conversions, the original prohibited access and partial-output cleanup.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
